You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:

CREATE TABLE TV_Channel (
    id TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    series_name TEXT,
    Country TEXT,
    Language TEXT,
    Content TEXT,
    Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR TEXT,
    Hight_definition_TV TEXT,
    Pay_per_view_PPV TEXT,
    Package_Option TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id)
);

CREATE TABLE TV_series (
    id REAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    Episode TEXT,
    Air_Date TEXT,
    Rating TEXT,
    Share REAL,
    18_49_Rating_Share TEXT,
    Viewers_m TEXT,
    Weekly_Rank REAL,
    Channel TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (Channel) REFERENCES TV_Channel(id)
);

CREATE TABLE Cartoon (
    id REAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    Title TEXT,
    Directed_by TEXT,
    Written_by TEXT,
    Original_air_date TEXT,
    Production_code REAL,
    Channel TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (Channel) REFERENCES TV_Channel(id)
);

When you have a final SQL query to present, always wrap it in a sql markdown code fence like this:

```sql
SELECT ...
```

This makes it easy to identify your answer. Only use one ```sql fence for your final query.

A good starting point for TV series popularity analysis is to summarize performance by channel/series using average viewers, share, and weekly rank.

```sql
SELECT
    c.id AS channel_id,
    c.series_name,
    c.Country,
    c.Language,
    COUNT(t.id) AS episodes_count,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.Viewers_m, 'm', ''), 'M', '') AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_viewers_m,
    ROUND(AVG(t.Share), 2) AS avg_share,
    ROUND(AVG(t.Weekly_Rank), 2) AS avg_weekly_rank
FROM TV_Channel c
JOIN TV_series t
    ON c.id = t.Channel
GROUP BY
    c.id,
    c.series_name,
    c.Country,
    c.Language
ORDER BY
    avg_viewers_m DESC,
    avg_share DESC,
    avg_weekly_rank ASC;
```
I wanna find out the minimum share of all TV series.

```sql
SELECT
    MIN(Share) AS minimum_share
FROM TV_series
WHERE Share IS NOT NULL;
```
I also want to know the max share of all TV series.

```sql
SELECT
    MAX(Share) AS maximum_share
FROM TV_series
WHERE Share IS NOT NULL;
```
